page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes on the left (keyed by letters a to e) and marginal line numbers on the right. Running head top right, page number top left. Catchword at the lower right.
page.notes: Printed marginal line numbers on the right (5 to 55) are transcribed as notes at approximate line positions. Marginal letters a to e are keyed to text marks; placement of the text marks {a} and {e} is inferred from the margin. Ink blots cover parts of several lines (near "Principum", "Christianis", "ad" in the lower right and the final lines), so several words are uncertain and marked [?] or illegible. The first line begins mid-word ("nati"), a fragment carried over from the previous page. The catchword "tempo-" is taken from the lower right.
